recipes.name: Egg Muffins with Tomato, Basil and Spinach
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: Olive oil or vegetable spray to coat pan

steps: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly oil a 12-cup muffin pan.
Whisk eggs with salt, pepper and basil.
Divide egg mixture between muffin cups, no more than halfway full.
Add onion, garlic, spinach, tomato and mozzarella evenly.
Bake uncovered for 15–20 minutes, until eggs are set.
recipes.note: Make ahead and refrigerate or freeze; reheat before serving.
recipes.searchText: egg muffins with tomato, basil and spinach breakfast 12 eggs ¼ cup onion, diced 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp dried basil ¼ tsp salt ¼ tsp pepper 2 cups spinach, chopped 12 cherry tomatoes, chopped 1 cup shredded mozzarella olive oil or vegetable spray to coat pan

recipes.name: Spicy Matador Breakfast Burrito
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 30 oz canned black beans, no salt added (about 2 cans)

steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Whisk eggs and set aside.
Cook onion, bell pepper, jalapeño, beans and chili powder for 3–5 minutes until softened. Transfer to a covered bowl.
Cook eggs over medium-low heat, stirring until firm, about 3–5 minutes. Add cheese and season.
Divide eggs, beans and vegetables among tortillas. Top with cilantro, yogurt and lime. Add toppings after reheating if storing.
recipes.searchText: spicy matador breakfast burrito breakfast 5 eggs 2 tsp chili powder ¼ cup red onion, diced 1 bell pepper, diced 1 jalapeño, seeded and minced 30 oz canned black beans, no salt added (about 2 cans) ½ cup shredded cheese 1 tsp olive oil 4 (8-inch) whole wheat flour tortillas ⅓ cup nonfat plain yogurt ¼ cup water ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped 1 lime, quartered salt and pepper to taste

recipes.name: Honey-Yogurt and Oats
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: Mix yogurt, cinnamon and honey in a jar or bowl.
Layer oats and berries over the yogurt.
Add walnuts just before serving, or after chilling overnight.
recipes.searchText: honey-yogurt and oats breakfast 1 cup nonfat greek yogurt ¼ cup rolled oats 1 cup berries, fresh or frozen 1 tbsp honey ¼ tsp cinnamon ½ oz walnuts (about 6–8 halves)

recipes.name: Almond Butter and Banana Triangles
recipes.meta: 1 recipe / 1 serving · Prep 5 min · Total 10 min
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 2 Tbsp almond butter (or nut butter of choice)

steps: Warm tortillas in a skillet over medium heat.
Spread almond butter across both tortillas. Arrange banana on one and drizzle with honey.
Place the second tortilla on top to make a sandwich.
Cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Cut into quarters.
recipes.searchText: almond butter and banana triangles pre-workout 2 tbsp almond butter (or nut butter of choice) 2 medium whole-wheat tortillas 1 ripe banana, sliced 1 tsp honey

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Energy Bites
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: If dates are dry, soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.
Blend dates until smooth; add a little reserved soaking water if needed.
Blend in oats and coconut.
Mash banana in a bowl, add the mixture and stir in chia seeds, cocoa, honey and peanut butter.
Form into balls and refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 1 week.
recipes.searchText: peanut butter energy bites post-workout 1 cup oats ½ cup peanut butter ½ cup unsweetened shredded coconut 1 ripe banana 1½ tbsp chia seeds 2 tbsp cocoa powder 6 pitted dates 1–2 tbsp honey

recipes.name: Pomegranate + Pistachio Granola Bars
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: Mix oats, peanut butter, pistachios, chocolate chips, honey, pomegranate and cinnamon.
Line an 8×8-inch pan with parchment and press mixture into an even layer.
Cover and refrigerate 30–60 minutes until firm.
Slice into bars and wrap individually for refrigerator or freezer storage.
recipes.note: Dried cranberries or cherries can replace pomegranate arils.
recipes.searchText: pomegranate + pistachio granola bars post-workout 2 cups quick-cooking oats 1 cup peanut butter ½ cup shelled pistachios ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 tbsp honey ½ cup pomegranate arils 1 tsp cinnamon

recipes.name: Recovery Smoothie
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Add extra liquid if needed.
recipes.note: Cookbook nutrition is listed per smoothie.
recipes.searchText: recovery smoothie post-workout 1 cup nonfat plain greek yogurt ¼ cup frozen blueberries ¼ cup frozen blackberries ¼ cup frozen strawberries ½ cup tart cherry juice 2 cups water 2 cups spinach 30 g protein powder 1 tbsp hulled hemp hearts

recipes.name: Herbed Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess liquid with a paper towel.
Combine chicken, yogurt, cucumber, chives, dill, garlic, lemon juice and vinegar. Mix well.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve in salads, sandwiches or with crackers.
recipes.searchText: herbed greek yogurt chicken salad lunch & dinner 8 oz cooked, shredded chicken breast 1 cup nonfat plain greek yogurt ½ cucumber, shredded ¼ cup chopped chives ¼ cup chopped dill 1 clove garlic, minced juice of ½ lemon 1 tbsp red wine vinegar salt and pepper to taste

recipes.name: Quick Pesto Chicken
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray a baking dish with non-stick oil.
Layer chicken breast with pesto, tomato and mozzarella.
Bake 25–30 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F internally.
recipes.searchText: quick pesto chicken lunch & dinner 8 oz chicken breast 1 oz pesto 2 large tomatoes, sliced 2 oz mozzarella cheese

recipes.name: Protein + Veggie Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Rinse quinoa and simmer in 2 cups water for 15–20 minutes; cool.
Mince vegetables and remove tops and seeds from peppers.
Cook carrots, celery, mushrooms, onion and garlic in olive oil until softened, adding water as needed.
Cook tofu in a skillet for 6–8 minutes (the cookbook notes ground turkey or chicken can be substituted).
Mix quinoa, protein and vegetables; season with oregano, salt and pepper. Stuff peppers and top with optional feta.
Place peppers in a baking dish with 1 cup water, cover with sprayed foil and bake 45–60 minutes until tender.
recipes.searchText: protein + veggie stuffed bell peppers lunch & dinner 1 cup dry quinoa 4 large bell peppers 2 carrots, minced 1 celery stalk, minced 5 white button mushrooms, minced ¼ white onion, minced 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp olive oil 8 oz firm tofu, crumbled 1 tbsp dried oregano salt and pepper 1 cup feta cheese (optional)

recipes.name: Overnight Chia & Berry Oats
recipes.meta: 1 serving · Prep 5 min · Total 5 min (plus overnight chill)
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 1/2 cup 1% milk or unsweetened almond milk

steps: Combine oats, chia seeds, and protein powder in a jar or container.
Stir in the milk until fully mixed.
Top with frozen berries.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Stir before eating in the morning.
recipes.searchText: overnight chia & berry oats breakfast 1/2 cup rolled oats 1 tablespoon chia seeds 1/2 cup 1% milk or unsweetened almond milk 1/2 cup frozen mixed berries 1/2 scoop vanilla protein powder (optional)

recipes.name: Quick Spinach & Egg Wrap
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: Pinch of salt and black pepper

steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour over spinach, and scramble until cooked.
Place scrambled eggs onto the tortilla, wrap tightly, and serve.
recipes.searchText: quick spinach & egg wrap breakfast 1 whole wheat tortilla (8-inch) 2 large eggs 1 cup fresh baby spinach 1 teaspoon olive oil pinch of salt and black pepper

recipes.name: Batch-Prep Chicken & Quinoa Salad
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked and diced
Salt, pepper, and dried oregano to taste

steps: Cook quinoa and chicken in advance, allowing them to cool.
In a large bowl, combine the diced chicken, quinoa, tomatoes, and cucumber.
Whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss well. Divide into four meal prep containers.
recipes.searchText: batch-prep chicken & quinoa salad lunch & dinner 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cooked and diced 2 cups cooked quinoa 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved 1 english cucumber, diced 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons lemon juice salt, pepper, and dried oregano to taste

recipes.name: Lentil & Sweet Potato Stew
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 1 cup dry brown or green lentils, rinsed
2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced

steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onions and sauté until translucent.
Stir in cumin and paprika, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add lentils, sweet potatoes, diced tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until lentils and potatoes are tender.
Divide into four containers for easy reheating.
recipes.searchText: lentil & sweet potato stew lunch & dinner 1 cup dry brown or green lentils, rinsed 2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and diced 1 medium yellow onion, chopped 1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes 4 cups low-sodium vegetable broth 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon cumin and 1 teaspoon paprika

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Turkey Sausage & Veggies
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 12 oz pre-cooked lean turkey sausage, sliced
1 teaspoon garlic powder, salt, and pepper

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (205°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the sliced turkey sausage, bell peppers, onion, and broccoli on the pan.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Roast for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender. Divide into three portions.
recipes.searchText: sheet pan turkey sausage & veggies lunch & dinner 12 oz pre-cooked lean turkey sausage, sliced 2 medium bell peppers, sliced 1 medium red onion, sliced 2 cups broccoli florets 1.5 tablespoons olive oil 1 teaspoon garlic powder, salt, and pepper

recipes.name: Tuna & Avocado Mash on Whole Grain
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 1 can (5 oz) chunk light tuna in water, drained
Salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice

steps: In a small bowl, mash the avocado and Greek yogurt together with a fork.
Stir in the drained tuna, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Toast the whole wheat bread.
Spread the tuna and avocado mixture evenly over the toast and serve.
recipes.searchText: tuna & avocado mash on whole grain lunch & dinner 1 can (5 oz) chunk light tuna in water, drained 1/4 medium avocado, mashed 1 tablespoon plain greek yogurt 2 slices 100% whole wheat bread salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice

recipes.name: Nut & Berry Mix
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 1 oz raw almonds or walnuts (about a small handful)

steps: Portion out the nuts and berries.
Eat together for a balanced mix of healthy fats, fiber and fruit that keeps you going through the afternoon.
recipes.searchText: nut & berry mix snack 1 oz raw almonds or walnuts (about a small handful) 1/2 cup fresh berries (blueberries or strawberries)

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt & Almond Butter Cup
recipes.footnote: Nutrition per serving, as listed in the cookbook.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon almond butter or peanut butter

steps: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Stir in the almond butter and top with a dusting of cinnamon.
Mix well and enjoy as a high-protein, satiating snack.
recipes.searchText: greek yogurt & almond butter cup snack 3/4 cup plain low-fat greek yogurt 1 tablespoon almond butter or peanut butter 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon
